methodology.note: Production K22 selection model used walk-forward. Conversion layouts were generated without target outcomes. Historical research is not an untouched validation set for the already-developed selection model.

observed_jackpots_over_150.note: No tested 555-line architecture produced an actual historical 6/6 ticket in the 150 target draws.

interpretation.reason: 400/100/55 increases conditional jackpot conversion when K22 contains all six by one third versus 300/170/85 (0.5361% vs 0.4021%), while eight-seed mean P(4+) was nearly unchanged in the latest 50 (33.25% vs 33.5%) and only modestly lower over 150 draws (31.92% vs 33.0%). More aggressive pure-K22 allocations showed clearer degradation in 3+/4+ robustness.
interpretation.caution: All 555 distinct-line portfolios have the same unconditional lottery jackpot probability absent genuine predictive information in the selection model. The conditional figures describe conversion efficiency after a K22 pool-selection event, not a change in the lottery's base odds.
